headline: Strong aerospace demand lifts profit, cash balance falls
summary_short: GE Aerospace's Q2 FY2026 revenue rose 21% y/y to $13.35B, with net income up 17% to $2.37B and diluted EPS of $2.26. Cash and restricted cash fell to $9.35B as buybacks and dividends outpaced operating cash flow.
summary_long: Revenue grew 21% y/y to $13.35B, led by Equipment growth from higher engine deliveries/pricing and Services growth from higher shop-visit volume, workscopes and spare-parts demand. Operating income rose 22% to $2.56B and net income increased 17% to $2.37B (diluted EPS $2.26), driven by higher segment profit across CES (+20% profit) and DPT (+18% profit), partly offset by higher Corporate & Other costs and interest charges. Total RPO reached $210.8B, up 11% from year-end 2025. Cash and restricted cash fell to $9.35B from $10.86B a year ago as $6.4B of financing outflows — including $4.2B of YTD buybacks and higher dividends — outpaced $5.1B of operating cash flow. The 10-Q disclosed no explicit forward guidance for Q3 or full-year 2026.

drivers.explanation: Growth was broad-based: CES revenue +27% on shop-visit volume/workscopes, spare parts and engine deliveries; DPT revenue +16% on volume and price; both segments grew profit faster than the prior year.
Equipment revenue increased on higher engine deliveries and improved pricing; Services revenue increased on higher internal shop-visit volume, workscopes, and spare-parts volume and pricing.
CES profit growth was driven by shop-visit volume/workscopes, spare parts and price, partly offset by higher install engine deliveries, growth investment and inflation.
Increase driven by segment profit +$0.5B and higher gains on retained/sold ownership interests, partly offset by higher interest charges and Adjusted Corporate & Other costs.

Balance fell as $6.4B of financing outflows (treasury buybacks +$0.8B y/y, higher dividends) and $1.9B of investing outflows outpaced $5.1B of operating cash flow, despite operating cash flow rising $1.2B y/y.
Decline reflects $4.5B of YTD treasury stock purchases and dividends exceeding net income added to retained earnings during the trailing year.
Share count fell as the company repurchased 6.9 million shares for $2,012 million in the quarter and 14.1 million shares for $4,223 million year-to-date.
